title: 25 Lake District Lane Vacation Rental
meta_description: 25 Lake District Lane is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 10)- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Cars- Natural Gas Grill- Large Covered & Screened Porches- Exterior Shower- Located in the heart of WaterColor’s Cottage District- Steps to Tennis Center- Steps away to Seaside Square- 3 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club Access DETAILS:Coastal charm abounds in this amazing 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath cottage located in the heart of WaterColor at 25 Lake District Lane. The open-concept layout of the first floor allows a wonderful flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas while the cool neutral tones, lavish furnishings and exquisite artwork throughout offer a refreshing and relaxing welcome to guests entering the home. The first floor also features a half-bathroom, laundry room and fabulous master bedroom hosting a king bed and a private bathroom with walk-in shower and soaking tub. Just up the stairs are two additional guestrooms with ensuite bathrooms, both hosting two queen sized beds in each room. Additionally, there is a daybed with trundle in its own nook between the two bedrooms on this floor. Escape outside to the sprawling covered and screened porches to discover the best of both worlds as you will find peaceful wooded views are abundant here while also enjoying easy accessibility to Seaside, the Tennis Center, Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club. This exceptional WaterColor home gives you the serenity you have been craving and the amenities you need (including 4 adult bikes!), making it a truly great gathering spot for everyone to spend time together and make memories that last forever! Contact Sanders Beach Rentals today to book your next unforgettable getaway! FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower & Soaking Tub- Kitchen- Living Room- Dining Area- Half Bath- Laundry Room SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds (4), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds (4), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination- Daybed with Trundle (2) PLEASE NOTE: All golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
